ethics.title: Food before politics: India's corridor offer
ethics.news: India offered to mediate food corridors through the Black Sea, as Russia's blocking of grain exports hurts hundreds of millions worldwide.
ethics.syllabus: Ethics in international relations; humanitarian values; peace
ethics.link: When national interests make a full settlement hard, a humanitarian step, letting food move, puts human need above strategic gain. India acts as a bridge rather than a bystander, speaking for poorer nations that suffer from a war they did not fight.
ethics.question: "Ethics in international relations begins where human suffering is placed above strategic interest." Discuss with reference to India's offer to mediate food corridors in the Black Sea.
